skills.name: Shadow Transition
skills.description:
Helcurt blinks to the target location, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% (decays over 1.5s). Hitting an enemy hero or creep with this skill grants Helcurt 1 <font color='#404495'>(Deadly Stinger)</font>.
<font color='#404495'>(Dark Night Falls)</font>: Enemies hit are also silenced for 1.5s.
skills.tips: A skill with super high mobility. Using in the early game allows Helcurt to move through walls to speed up jungling. Using in middle-late game makes it a good initiating skill or escape by moving through terrains.

skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.description:
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Each Basic Attack grants 1 <font color='#404495'>(Deadly Stinger)</font>. Up to 5 stingers can be stored for 8s, after which the number of stingers will decrease over time.
<font color='#404495'>(Active)</font>: Helcurt fires all <font color='#404495'>(Deadly Stingers)</font> in the target direction, each dealing 180<font color='#D58E1F'>( +80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies (Minions and Creeps only take 70% of the damage) and slowing them by 8% for 3s (the slow effect can stack).
<font color='#404495'>(Deadly Stinger)</font> counts as a Basic Attack, but it cannot Crit.
skills.tips: Storing up to 5 stingers to maximize the damage as it's the core damage skill. Since it can penetrate the targets, choose a good angle to hit more enemies or jungle monsters to speed up the jungling.

skills.name: Dark Night Falls
skills.description:
Helcurt summons the <font color='#404495'>(Dark Night)</font>, greatly reducing all enemy heroes' sight range for 3.5s. He also gains 10% extra Attack Speed and 65% extra Movement Speed for 8s and 1 <font color='#404495'>(Deadly Stinger)</font>. The number of Stingers won't drop during the night. <font color='#404495'>(Dark Night Falls)</font> has no effect on enemy Helcurt.
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Helcurt's Attack Speed is increased by 10%.
skills.tips: Use it anytime anywhere to make all enemy heroes lose vision by 3.5s (except Helcurt). A very useful skill. The bonus movement speed allows him to go to the fight quickly or chase an enemy. The bonus attack speed substantially increases his burst damage. Let the enemies fear the invisibility. P.S: It's not effective on enemy Helcurt.

skills.name: Race Advantage
skills.description: Enemy heroes who inflict control effects on Helcurt will be silenced for 1.5s. Cooldown: 4s.
skills.tips: A very sick passive skill. This allows Helcurt to take damage from skills and silenced targets. P.S: Hitting by a long ranged skill will not trigger this passive!

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.des: Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 <1025 0.4> Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5s.

items.name: Flame Hunter's Swift Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Hunter: After dealing damage to a Creep, deal 25<2|lv 3> + <1005 0.01> True Damage to the target over 3s (damage is increased by 100% for non-Marksmen heroes).

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Helcurt has strong silencing abilities but few damage abilities. His damage mostly comes from basic attacks and 2nd skill. 2nd skill has a short cooldown, Endless Battle grants lifesteal, the passive - Divine Justice and Chase Fate can be triggered easily; Demon Hunter Sword and Scarlet Phantom substantially increase his attack speed, they are good for farming and 2nd skill's passive. Rose Gold Meteor and Immortality boost his durability and make him a real mage killer.
